description: Tinyproxy: a small HTTP and HTTPS (CONNECT) forward proxy with ACLs, filtering and upstream chaining. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

CrowdSec: log-based attack detection with community scenarios; the Local API serves block decisions to bouncers. LAPI Deployment plus an agent DaemonSet reading node logs. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

HAProxy Kubernetes Ingress Controller: Ingress through HAProxy with rate limiting, IP allow and deny lists and ACLs as annotations. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source on QuenchWorks HAProxy, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Coraza SPOA: the OWASP Coraza web application firewall as an HAProxy SPOE agent, with the OWASP Core Rule Set compiled in. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
